description: Findings whose proposed status change was considered and rejected by the register. Each entry names the register row (or evidence) that refutes the finding — never a bare ignore list.

rejections.refuting_row: CODE.WZO2-INCOMPLETE (now FALSE-AS-SCOPED; the true count is 131,068 provably unreachable entries per CODE.WZO2-PASS1-LAW, absorbed T279)
rejections.rationale: The register correctly refuted T212's PROVEN proposal. CODE.WZO2-INCOMPLETE (2026-08-02) was CLAIMED based on a ~6.77M estimate later found 51.7× overstated (T266, verified T277, absorbed T279). The artifact is structurally complete at the entry level (CODE.WZO2-PASS1-LAW:PROVEN) but still not verified for closure or value-correctness. The WZO2-4X4-VALID row in CLAIMS.md records the reasoning: 'passing every check we had did not make the artifact valid, because no check we had tested completeness or value-correctness.' This is one of the project's better epistemic moments (GRAND-AUDIT §5). Corrected 2026-08-03 (T279).
